name: Muneyama Mashiro
source:
First-year student. Member of the Literary Club. The protagonist's stepsister.

She has adored the protagonist - her older brother - for a long time and loves being pampered by him. At the same time, she also enjoys pampering him; when their parents and their childhood friend Yuse are away, she takes care of the cooking and laundry. (However, because Yuse is rarely away, she doesn't get to do housework very often.) Her skills are improving rapidly.

She can't hold back her love for her brother and always seeks affection from him. When her brother isn't involved, she's just a classic refined beauty, but when he is in the mix, she tends to get carried away regardless of time and place.

She's an obvious brocon. Even now she lives in the same room with her brother. Because her views on men have been thoroughly destroyed by her brother, she can't develop romantic feelings for any men except him.
